description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to running and managing containers using the runc implementation within the Thunder process container framework. It includes class definitions for RunCContainer and RunCContainerAdministrator, along with their methods and member variables.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the runc implementation, providing methods to control and query container state.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing RunCContainer instances.

methods.name: RunCContainer(const string& id, const string& path, const string& logPath)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a RunCContainer with specified identifiers and paths.

methods.name: Type()
methods.description: Returns the container type, which is RUNC.

methods.name: Pid()
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning()
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start(const string& command, IStringIterator& parameters)
methods.description: Starts the container with the specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: Memory()
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo()
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: InternalPurge(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Performs internal cleanup of the container with an optional timeout.

methods.name: RunCContainerAdministrator()
methods.description: Default constructor for the container administrator.

methods.name: Container(const string& id, IStringIterator& searchpaths, const string& logpath, const string& configuration)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on provided parameters.

methods.name: Initialize(const string& configuration)
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with a given configuration.
